moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio glow-pulse, written here): Looping glow on a 36 px accent dot, 1100 ms per cycle, each half eased in-out (site runtime bezier .45,.05,.2,1; recipe sine.inOut): box-shadow blur 8 → 26 → 8 px (recipe 8 → 24, opacity 35 → 85 %), brightness 0.92 → 1.22, scale 0.98 → 1.03 (the target is not still). Behind it a 48 px ring with an 8 px accent border: scale 0.9 → 1.35, opacity 0.28 → 0.9, blur 5 → 10 px, same cycle. Params: period (1.1 s) · glow (8 → 26 px) · brightness (0.92 → 1.22) · scale (0.98 → 1.03) · color.
